انتزعا (form VIII)

# اُنْتُزِعَا (untuziʕā) /un.tu.zi.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
# اِنْتَزِعَا (intaziʕā) /in.ta.zi.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِنْتَزَعَ (intazaʕa)
